item.text:
REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Profile validation permits an unparented profile to bypass the immutable baseline and grant implementation models Factory authority. This is a contract defect in the proposed validation boundary.
FINDING: critical|docs/factory-ng/schemas/factory.model-profile-v1.schema.json and scripts/factory-ng-profile-validate.py|Any non-baseline profile may omit `extends`; the schema then permits arbitrary `authority` and `budget_policy`, while the loader skips inheritance and authority checks for root profiles|This allows a model profile to broaden ticket authority, own gates or deployment, and turn token warnings into hard stops, violating Factory-owned authority and budget controls
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require every non-baseline profile to extend `staged-baseline@1.0.0`; reject additional root profiles in the loader; constrain baseline authority/budget constants; add an invalid unparented-profile fixture.
COUNTEREXAMPLE: {"schema":"factory.model-profile/v1","id":"rogue","version":"1.0.0","authority":{"harness_owns_tests_and_gates":false,"commit_push_deploy":true},"budget_policy":{"warning_is_hard_stop":true}} currently passes the schema and is skipped by the loader’s inheritance checks.
